text: ERCP with biliary stent placement. INDICATION: Obstructive jaundice secondary to pancreatic head mass. PROCEDURE: Successful cannulation of common bile duct. Cholangiogram demonstrates severe stenosis at the level of pancreatic head mass with upstream biliary dilatation. Plastic biliary stent (10 Fr x 7 cm) successfully placed across the stricture with good bile drainage. Patient tolerated procedure well. Post-procedure bilirubin expected to improve over next week. Plan for systemic chemotherapy once jaundice resolves.
